deals.soloWhy: Cheap base for Orlando and the Space Coast, but SFB is a small airport and a car is practically required.

highlights: Wekiwa Springs spring swim and paddling
itinerary: Day 1 — Downtown Sanford riverwalk, Lake Monroe sunset
Day 2 — Blue Spring State Park manatees, then Wekiwa Springs paddle
Day 3 — Canaveral National Seashore morning, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Rental car needed; SFB is ~35 min from Orlando proper.
guide.stayArea: Downtown Sanford for walkable dining near the riverfront.

deals.soloWhy: Small, walkable harbor town with a bike-friendly Harborwalk; quiet rather than social.

highlights: Punta Gorda Harborwalk and Fishermen's Village
Myakka River canopy walkway and boat tour
Boca Grande day trip via Gasparilla Island
itinerary: Day 1 — Harborwalk, sunset at Laishley Park
Day 2 — Myakka River State Park canopy walkway and airboat tour
Day 3 — Kayak the Peace River, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Rental car for parks and beaches; downtown is walkable.

deals.travelWindow: Feb 13 – Apr 24, 2027 (new Allegiant route; intro one-way from $49)
deals.whyRanked: Repeat from Nov 18 (no fresh price change found): New Allegiant BOS–PIE nonstop from Feb 13, 2027 with intro one-way from $49; walkable and arts-rich, with Fort De Soto and Egmont Key nearby.
deals.soloWhy: One of Florida's most walkable downtowns with museums, a pier and a waterfront trail, easy to do solo without a car.

highlights: St. Pete Pier and Waterfront Trail
Central Ave murals and Warehouse Arts District
Fort De Soto beaches and bike trails
itinerary: Day 1 — St. Pete Pier, Dalí Museum, Central Ave
Day 2 — Fort De Soto Park by bike or car; Egmont Key ferry
Day 3 — Warehouse Arts District murals, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable with free Looper trolley and scooters; car helpful for Fort De Soto.

deals.travelWindow: Jan 5 – Feb 3, 2027 (Tue/Wed-heavy departures; fare posted Oct 13, may have aged)
deals.whyRanked: $193 RT nonstop on JetBlue (Slickdeals, Oct 13 post; $199 on JetBlue direct) for Jan 2027; Savannah is one of the most walkable, safe solo cities in the South, with Tybee Island and Wormsloe nearby.
deals.soloWhy: Compact historic squares are walkable and safe, with hostels and free DOT shuttle; easy day trips to Tybee.

highlights: Forsyth Park and the 22 historic squares
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk the squares from Forsyth Park to River Street; Savannah Historic District
Day 2 — Fort Pulaski in the morning, Tybee Island beach and lighthouse after
Day 3 — Wormsloe oak avenue, Telfair Museums, then depart
guide.gettingAround: Downtown is walkable and the free DOT shuttle covers the core; rent a car or rideshare for Tybee and Wormsloe.
guide.stayArea: Historic District near Forsyth Park for walkability and dining.
food: Mrs. Wilkes' Dining Room (family-style Southern lunch)
